subject: Mobile Development
title: Bluetooth and Near-Field Connections
description: A fast breakdown of Bluetooth and Near-Field Connections for builders.

hook.text: Your phone connects to earbuds, watches, and car stereos without any cables.

buildup.text: Bluetooth Low Energy uses tiny amounts of power to maintain short-range connections.

discovery.text: NFC lets two devices communicate by touching — powering contactless payments.

twist.text: COVID contact tracing apps used Bluetooth beacons to detect nearby phones anonymously.

climax.text: Short-range wireless turns phones into controllers for an ever-growing ecosystem of devices.
